calculation.description: The lagged ratio of 20-session net price return to the total absolute daily return path. Higher values identify persistent directional trends; lower values identify choppy or reversal-prone paths. Cross-sectional use is positive (higher efficiency forecasts higher forward return).

validation.regime_notes: Strong in 2020-2025 (IC 0.07488 for 2020-2022; 0.04025 for 2023-2025), negative in 2026 onward (IC -0.01081 in 2026-2027, -0.00976 in 2028-2030, -0.03314 in 2031 YTD). Aggregate admission passes narrowly; use conservatively and revalidate for drift.
